topic: Turn Claude into your Ops assistant with Projects
post:
Stop re-explaining your job to AI every single morning. ⚙️
One Claude feature fixes that for operations teams: Projects.

A Project is a workspace where every chat automatically inherits:

📁 Your files: SOPs, process docs, templates, policies
🧭 Your instructions: tone, format, role, rules
💬 Its own chat history, kept separate from everything else

How I'd set up an "Ops Assistant" Project in 10 minutes:

1️⃣ Create a Project called "Ops Assistant"
2️⃣ Upload your top 5 SOPs and your report templates
3️⃣ Add instructions like:
"You are my operations analyst. Follow our SOPs exactly. Answer in bullets. Flag risks and missing data. End with next actions and owners."
4️⃣ Start every ops task inside that Project

What it's great for:
• Drafting SOP updates from rough notes
• Turning meeting notes into action items with owners
• Writing incident summaries in your standard format
• Checking a new process against your existing policies

Why it matters:
The biggest time sink with AI isn't the answer. It's rebuilding context every time. Projects make the context permanent.

What's the first SOP you'd upload? 👇

Follow me for a daily Claude tip that saves you real time.
